summary: Profiled Pulsar: ~400 tiny offscreen passes a frame come from the role-outline filters on ~32 pieces (aura.ts); the cut is a render.switches.auraBake that caches each outline layer, gated by a pixel diff and a same-run ABABAB perf comparison.
notes: Probes: docs/progress/v1.4/work/C3/probe-gpu.ts and probe-who.ts. Skipping offscreen draws drops 4x p95 33.3 to 18.6 ms (the CPU floor); paint, twinkle, canvas visibility have no effect.

Risk to watch: cacheAsTexture bounds exclude blur reach (padding rect in the packet) and filter space at devicePixelRatio 2 (fallback: manual RenderTexture). The look gate can set the default off and send options to HG-C.
The hard perf check skips when the cuts-off p95 is already within 1.25 vsyncs (at 1x on a good run it is); a spec decision for the reviewer to confirm.
Depends on C4c being committed first; the packet is written against its working tree.
